title: Compose the Card atom's room for more content into Architecture Studio's node view via Graph IR tags
objective: The owner asked to put the new Card atom to work in Architecture Studio so each node card holds more than one element. EntitySummary already composes Card privately; this task adds a tags row (existing, real Graph IR node.tags data, not invented content) rendered as compact badges inside the card, and plumbs it end to end: GraphIrNode.tags -> CanvasNode.data -> EntitySummaryProps.tags -> rendered badges inside CardView. Architecture Studio's own source stays React-free; it only supplies plain data through mountEntitySummary, exactly like today.

risks: The Architecture Studio node card has a fixed 288x84 size shared with the Rust layout request; a tag row is capped to a small number of tags and the card keeps overflow:hidden, so an entity with many tags is deliberately clipped rather than resized. Resizing the node to fit unbounded tag counts is a separate, larger change (Rust layout options too) and is out of scope here.

No in-app browser backend is available in this session (the same limitation every prior Architecture Studio visual task recorded), so the actual rendered tag row cannot be visually confirmed here; only server-rendered (SSR) structural contracts and a production build are verified.

This task does not touch packages/x6-canvas; the generic canvas contracts (CanvasNode.data is already opaque `unknown`) do not need to change for the application to add a new field to its own product-owned node data shape.
Per DEC-053/ADR-0015, this task will prepare uncommitted changes only; the repository owner must review and create the actual Git commit.
